name: Dzhankoi-Simferopol-Sevastopol Gas Pipeline (Soviet-era Crimean trunk)
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length or diameter; trunk name unconfirmed (main Soviet line is Glebovka-Simferopol)
researcher_notes: Crimean trunk to Simferopol and Sevastopol is real and operating, but no source gives a length or diameter for a Dzhankoi-Simferopol-Sevastopol line, and the main Soviet trunk is actually Glebovka-Simferopol (in service since 1966, 500 mm, per a neftegaz.ru analysis of the Chernomorneftegaz gas system). A Dzhankoi-Simferopol leg is not named anywhere found. The 92 km at 21 in comes only from a GulfPub trace, a lead source that cannot be cited. The neftegaz.ru 2015 route article (139571) says the Crimean system forks near Krasnoperekopsk toward Simferopol and Sevastopol, but gives no length. Not a duplicate of the 2016 Kuban-Crimea line (krasnodar-krai-crimea, new_row). No Crimea rows exist in the Ukraine GGIT context, so it is not matched to an existing row. Failed the length rule (sourced length of at least 25 km). Next step if revisited: find Chernomorneftegaz or Crimeagasnet disclosure with segment lengths for Glebovka-Simferopol and Simferopol-Sevastopol, and consider vetting those instead. Occupying-power operator Chernomorneftegaz would be named as operator in notes only. Territory: wholly inside occupied Ukraine, so a Ukraine row if added.
